notes.title: Rapture Recovery Squad 1.0 Release is Out Today!
notes.content:
Rapture Recovery Squad 1.0 is here! This update includes:

[list]
[*] Five new roster entries to support the Zealot
[*] Four new curios
[*] A new dive, with more difficult enemy compositions to keep you on your toes
[*] Three new enemy types, including a new final boss for the new dive
[*] Performance improvements, focused on slowdown in menus
[*] Optimisations to help keep the file sizes small
[/list]

Whilst this marks the end of Early Access, updates will continue to come post launch.

A huge thank you to everyone who took part in Early Access. As a solo dev it's been very uplifting to see people playing the game, and your feedback has been invaluable to making the game more fun!

notes.title: V0.9.0: Two New Bosses!
notes.content:
This patch brings two new bosses, both designed to put the average roster to the test.

[b]Balance Changes[/b]

[list]
[*]Adjusted the weighting for a few fights. You should run into the defence king a little less on lower floors.
[*]Adjusted some numbers around enemy shielding to prevent it overwhelming early builds
[/list]

[b]Fixes[/b]

[list]
[*]Fixed a resolution bug that was popping up for some users
[/list]

My apologies for a lack of recent updates, an issue occurred with my two factor authentication (required to upload new builds to Steam).

notes.title: Content Update: Zealous Faith
notes.content:
[b]New Dive Lead: The Zealot[/b]

Bringing some cyber samurai flavour, the Zealot is the second dive lead available for the Faithful faction

[list]
[*]Use Showdown tags to mark multiple enemies for this dive lead to attack
[*]Two new roster entries to aid with adding these tags to your enemies
[*]More roster entries to support this lead will be coming next week
[/list]

[b]Fixes[/b]

[list]
[*]An issue where you can't go back with a right click should be fixed
[*]A bug causing the dive lead to have 20 health on some profiles has been fixed
[/list]

[b]Misc Changes[/b]

[list]
[*]To ensure people can quickly access the new content, all dive teams will be available to select as soon as you have completed the tutorial
[/list]

notes.title: Early Access Version 0.8.9: Reflections
notes.content:
[b]Ten new fights[/b] now exist in the depths, comprised of nine new enemies. These include one new elite fight to challenge your team's ability to deal fast damage.

[b]Balance Changes[/b]

[list]
[*]Fights now give some more money, so the shop should feel less useless as a node in the early game
[*]Several enemies have had their stats adjusted so that they don't blow you up on turn one if you have a bad draw
[*]Some later enemy waves will add more foes to compensate the adjusted stats
[/list]

[b]Fixes[/b]

[list]
[*]Fixed a bug that would cause the final boss of the dive to freeze if he had no space to take his turn
[/list]

notes.title: Content Update: Building Faith
notes.content:
Thanks so much to everyone that has played the game during it's first week, and especially to those who have taken the time to provide feedback (whether it's bugs or balance, I really appreciate it).

The first content update for Rapture Recovery squad includes six new roster entries for the Faithful faction (unlocked after completing one successful run).

These add some much needed abilities to the Faithful to allow strategies beyond just spamming units.

Please don't hesitate to let me know your thoughts on the game, whether in the Steam forums or in a review. Cheers!

[u][b]Gameplay Changes[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] You will now only be offered battle rewards from the faction of your dive lead. You can still find other faction roster entries in the shop and in events if you want to mix it up.
[*] Some roster entries have had their signal costs changed to make them more appealing to use
[/list]

[u][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] You can no longer use your active ability if you do not have enough signal to do so
[*] You can no longer select the fourth option during the rewards screen to endlessly remove roster entries from your build
[*] Anchorite now correctly costs signal to use
[*] The 'Rats!' event should no longer cause occassional game freezes
[/list]

notes.title: V0.8.4 Hotfix
notes.content: An enemy that would refuse to attack is no longer a pacifist.

notes.title: Patch 0.8.2: An Easier Start
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Added a unique, slightly easier battle list for the first floor, so you have some time to build your roster before the real fight begins on floor 2
[*]Fixed a freeze that can occur when an enemy can't find a target
[*]Temporarily removed the 'Lucky Skull' enemy, it will return to bless you in a future update
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Update: New Enemies & Curios
notes.content:
Thanks to everyone that played the demo during Next Fest. The demo will be up for a few more weeks to give more people the chance to have a go.

I've added a few more enemies and curios to the current demo, and implemented some fixes based upon all of the great feedback I received.

[h2]Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*]Some new enemies added to spice things up
[*]New curios added to help mix up your build
[/list]
[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixes an issue where the game would freeze when auto-detecting monitor resolutions
[*]The Begin Combat button now correctly appears every time
[*]A few small crashes that were caused by the game waiting for a signal were fixed
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Update: Fixes and Balance
notes.content:
Thanks to everyone that has sent me feedback so far (in the forums and privately), I've made a few changes to the demo build. 

It should be a bit smoother to play and offer a little more challenge.

[h2]Balance Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Potshot now costs 2 signal
[*]Some enemy wave numbers beefed up
[*]Some enemy reinforcement times lowered
[*]The final boss (Empty Throne) now summons two enemies per turn instead of one
[/list]
[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]'Rats!' now correctly spends signal and leaves your hand when activated 
[*]Personal Shield can now, as the entry reads, target your leader (no more getting wiped out on turn one if you don't draw any fighters)
[/list]
